The structure of Nd8Hg4As4 (reduced formula Nd2HgAs) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 16 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies tetrahedral coordination for As, Hg, and Nd centers, each surrounded by four of the other elements at 2.8678 Å; these tetrahedra exhibit corner-sharing between As–Hg, As–Nd, and Hg–Nd pairs, with Hg–Hg tetrahedra also showing edge-sharing. The resulting periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites.
